title: NYC-based BusRight, which provides an AI-powered platform to help school bus operators manage routes, communication, and more, raised $30M from Volition Capital (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Mike Wheatley / SiliconANGLE: NYC-based BusRight, which provides an AI-powered platform to help school bus operators manage routes, communication, and more, raised $30M from Volition Capital — BusRight Inc., a startup that's using artificial intelligence to ensure that school buses get students safely to their classes on time …
